description: a dusty plate with the dried remains of bread rolls, now rock-hard. not appetizing, but technically edible if you're desperate enough.
name: bread_plate

params.message: You scrape the dried remains of the rolls off the dusty plate and eat them. They are rock-hard and tasteless, and your jaw aches afterwards - but the hunger backs off.

item.fail_message: Only dust remains on the plate.
item.success_message: You eat the dried bread remains.
